name: tokenos-gas-tracker
description: Live gas fees across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Solana — slow / standard / fast tiers, USD cost per transaction type and the cheapest chain to deploy right now.
keywords: cheapest chain to deploy smart contract
how much does it cost to deploy a smart contract

interface.longDescription:
Ask for gas fees right now and get every supported chain side by side: base fee, slow / standard / fast priority tiers, the USD cost of a transfer, ERC-20 transfer, swap, NFT mint and contract deployment, trend and congestion, and which chain is cheapest at this moment. Estimate any transaction from gas or compute units, or rank chains by deployment cost for a given bytecode size. Live from public RPCs, read-only.

Tools:
• gas_now — Current fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Solana: base fee, slow/standard/fast tiers, USD cost per transaction type, trend and the cheapest chain.
• estimate_tx_cost — Cost of one transaction on a chain at a speed tier, by transaction type (transfer, erc20_transfer, swap, nft_mint, deploy) or explicit gas / compute units.
• cheapest_chain_to_deploy — Rank Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Solana by the cost of deploying a contract or program of a given bytecode size.

Targets questions like: “ethereum gas fees now”; “gas price today”; “base gas fee”; “arbitrum gas fees”; “solana priority fee”; “cheapest chain to deploy smart contract”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/gas-tracker

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.

positive.prompt: What are gas fees right now on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table with base fee, slow/standard/fast tiers, USD costs and the cheapest chain; renders the fee widget.
Returns the Ethereum row with base fee, tiers and trend.

positive.prompt: How much does a swap cost on Solana at the moment, fast speed?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the SOL and USD cost with the base-fee + priority-fee breakdown.

positive.prompt: Cheapest chain to deploy a 20 KB contract?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked table of chains with native and USD costs and the Solana rent note.

positive.prompt: Gas fees on Polygon right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Tool returns an unknown-chain error listing the five supported chains; the assistant relays that.
